study_identification_part.si4_title: Brain-Charting Autism and Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder Reveals Distinct and Overlapping Neurobiology

cm1_clarity_of_research_objectives.reason: The abstract explicitly states the study goals: using population (normative) modeling on a large multisite dataset to characterize cortical anatomy in autism and ADHD, benchmarked against brain-development reference models, and to examine sex and age differences, autistic traits, and co-occurrence. These statements directly correspond to clear research objectives and application purposes.
cm1_clarity_of_research_objectives.supporting_text: “Here, we used population modeling and a large, multisite neuroimaging dataset … to characterize cortical anatomy associated with autism and ADHD, benchmarked against models of average brain development… We also examined sex and age differences and relationship with autistic traits and explored the co-occurrence of autism and ADHD.”

nm1_clarity_of_inclusion_and_exclusion_c.reason: Healthy controls are described by source datasets and final post-QC numbers, and QC exclusions are specified (manual FSQC with 2.5 cutoff), but explicit control inclusion/exclusion criteria beyond diagnostic status and QC thresholds are not detailed for each dataset.
nm1_clarity_of_inclusion_and_exclusion_c.supporting_text:
“T1-weighted scans were combined from 49 sites across 7 datasets… The final dataset after quality control (QC) included 4255 individuals (1869 typically developing control participants…). … Individuals with magnetic resonance imaging data and a primary diagnosis of autism or ADHD or no diagnosis were included.”
“All scans underwent manual QC of raw image and FreeSurfer surface reconstructions… A cutoff of 2.5 was used for FSQC.”
nm1_clarity_of_inclusion_and_exclusion_c.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Sample and Datasets; Data Processing / Quality Control

nm2_handling_of_confounding_variables_in.reason: Key confounders age, sex, and site are addressed via ComBat harmonization with covariates age, sex, and diagnosis, and the reference models account for age, sex, and site/scanner. Analyses include Euler number and age as covariates, indicating explicit adjustment for confounding.
nm2_handling_of_confounding_variables_in.supporting_text:
“ComBat was applied… with each site treated as a batch and with covariates of age, sex, and diagnosis to preserve related biological variation.”
“Generalized additive models… accounted for effects of age, sex, and site/scanner.”
“All analyses included Euler number as a covariate, as well as age…”
nm2_handling_of_confounding_variables_in.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: Data Processing / ComBat and Accounting for Site Variability; Generation of Centile Scores; Statistical Analysis

nm3_clarity_of_data_sources_of_healthy_c.reason: The study lists the specific datasets supplying healthy control data (ABIDE, POND, HBN, ADHD200, Female ASD, UK AIMS, UCSD Biomarkers), satisfying the requirement to clearly describe data sources.
nm3_clarity_of_data_sources_of_healthy_c.supporting_text: “T1-weighted scans were combined from 49 sites across 7 datasets, including the ABIDE… the POND Network, the HBN… the ADHD200 Consortium, the Multimodal Developmental Neurogenetics of Females with ASD dataset…, the UK MRC-AIMS…, and the University of California San Diego Biomarkers of Autism study.”

nm4_description_of_image_acquisition_pro.reason: The study aggregates existing multisite datasets rather than newly collecting MRI data; per the guidance, acquisition protocol details are not applicable for existing datasets.

nm5_details_of_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing procedures are described: T1 images processed with FreeSurfer v6.0.1 using the Desikan-Killiany atlas, hemispheric averaging, manual QC with FSQC, and Euler number included as a covariate. These details cover software, steps, and QC.
nm5_details_of_data_preprocessing.supporting_text:
“T1 images from each dataset were processed using FreeSurfer, version 6.0.1… Regional estimates… were extracted based on the Desikan-Killiany atlas.”
“All scans underwent manual QC… using our FSQC tool… A cutoff of 2.5 was used for FSQC… we also included the FreeSurfer-derived Euler number as a covariate in all analyses.”
nm5_details_of_data_preprocessing.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: Data Processing / FreeSurfer and Cortical Parcellations; Quality Control

nm6_internal_data_validation_in_healthy_.reason: The study applies an existing normative model (BrainChart reference models) and does not train a new model requiring internal validation via data partitioning.

nm7_external_data_validation_in_healthy_.reason: No new normative model is developed; they use previously published reference models, so external validation of a newly trained model is not applicable.

nm8_details_of_normative_modeling_approa.reason: The paper leverages an existing BrainChart normative model rather than developing a new normative modeling approach within this study.

nm9_model_performance_and_calibration_on.reason: Model performance metrics on training data are not applicable because the study does not train a new normative model; it uses existing reference models.

nm10_demographics_and_characteristics_of.reason: There are no training/test partitions for a newly built model; centile scores are generated from an existing reference model, so partition-wise demographics are not applicable.
